about: Country cards for lives born in Philippines. Each card is dealt only to them (and a little more often than general cards). Sources are in each card's "src".

events.src: ===================== Philippines (PH) ===================== OFWs: an estimated 2.16 million Overseas Filipino Workers in 2023 (PSA Survey on Overseas Filipinos, via Philstar); placement fees may not exceed one month's basic salary, and none for domestic workers (DMW; PNA). Pay and housing multiples are ESTIMATES.

en..x: An agency offers a three-year contract abroad at about {a} a year. About 2.16 million Filipinos worked overseas in 2023. Placement fees can’t exceed one month’s pay, and domestic workers pay none.

zh..x: 一家中介给你一份三年的海外合约，年薪约{a}。2023年约有216万菲律宾人在海外工作。中介费不得超过一个月的工资，家政工完全不用付。

zht..x: 一家中介給你一份三年的海外合約，年薪約{a}。2023年約有216萬菲律賓人在海外工作。中介費不得超過一個月的薪水，家政工完全不用付。

events.src: Paluwagan: an informal rotating savings group; about 4% of adults save this way (BSP, via Moneymax). Risk ESTIMATE.

en..x: Officemates start a paluwagan: everyone pays a fixed amount every payday, and each payday one member takes the whole pot.

zh..x: 办公室同事开了一个互助会（paluwagan）：每个发薪日大家交固定金额，每次由一人拿走全部会钱。

zht..x: 辦公室同事開了一個互助會（paluwagan）：每個發薪日大家交固定金額，每次由一人拿走全部會錢。

events.src: Typhoons: about 20 tropical cyclones enter the Philippine Area of Responsibility each year, 8 or 9 crossing the country (PAGASA). The chance that a flood or storm reaches you comes from EM-DAT (people affected a year, 2000–2024: js/data.js); premiums, damage and preparation costs are ESTIMATES.

en..x: About 20 tropical cyclones enter the Philippine area each year, and 8 or 9 cross the country. Your home is in their path.

zh..x: 每年约有20个热带气旋进入菲律宾责任区，其中8到9个会穿越国土。你家正在它们的路径上。

zht..x: 每年約有20個熱帶氣旋進入菲律賓責任區，其中8到9個會穿越國土。你家正在它們的路徑上。

events.src: Pag-IBIG MP2: 7.10% tax-free dividends for 2024 (Pag-IBIG Fund, via ABS-CBN and Philstar); a five-year program. With 3% inflation, about 4% real: an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: yearly('mp2', { amt: a, until: age + 5 }, { rate: .04, lock: age + 5 }, 'trk.mp2')

en..x: Pag-IBIG’s MP2 is a five-year savings programme; it paid a tax-free 7.1% dividend for 2024.
en..mp2.s: About {a} a year for 5 years. About 4% a year after inflation.

zh..x: Pag-IBIG的MP2是五年期储蓄计划；2024年派发免税股息7.1%。
zh..mp2.s: 每年约{a}，存5年。扣除通胀后每年约4%。

zht..x: Pag-IBIG的MP2是五年期儲蓄計畫；2024年派發免稅股息7.1%。
zht..mp2.s: 每年約{a}，存5年。扣除通膨後每年約4%。

events.src: PhilHealth: 5% of income for direct contributors in 2025, floor ₱10,000 (₱500 a month) (PhilHealth Advisory 2025-0002): ₱6,000 a year ≈ 0.057 of the game's typical wage (₱105,000). Share of bills covered is an ESTIMATE.

en..x: As a self-employed member you pay PhilHealth yourself: 5% of your income in 2025, at least ₱500 a month.
en..join.h: It pays about half of your hospital bills.

zh..x: 自雇会员要自己缴国家健康保险（PhilHealth）：2025年是收入的5%，每月至少₱500。

zht..x: 自僱會員要自己繳國家健康保險（PhilHealth）：2025年是收入的5%，每月至少₱500。

events.src: SSS voluntary members: 15% of the monthly salary credit (from ₱5,000) from Jan 2025, all paid by the member; 120 monthly contributions earn a lifetime pension (Manila Bulletin; Grant Thornton). ₱9,000 a year ≈ 0.086; the pension (≈ ₱2,400 a month, ≈ 0.27) is an ESTIMATE.

en..x: Self-employed and voluntary members pay the whole SSS contribution themselves: 15% of the monthly salary credit they choose, from 2025. After 120 monthly contributions you get a pension for life.
en..pay.s: About {a} a year; a pension of about {b} a year from 60.

zh..x: 自雇和自愿会员要自己缴全部社会保障（SSS）费：2025年起是所选月薪基数的15%。缴满120个月就能终身领养老金。
zh..pay.s: 每年约{a}；60岁起每年领约{b}的养老金。

zht..x: 自僱和自願會員要自己繳全部社會保障（SSS）費：2025年起是所選月薪基數的15%。繳滿120個月就能終身領退休金。
zht..pay.s: 每年約{a}；60歲起每年領約{b}的退休金。

events.src: 13th-month pay: one-twelfth of basic salary, paid by 24 December (Presidential Decree 851).

en..x: By law your 13th-month pay, a twelfth of a year’s basic salary, must be paid by 24 December.

zh..x: 依法第十三个月薪水，即全年基本工资的十二分之一，必须在12月24日前发放。

zht..x: 依法第十三個月薪水，即全年基本薪水的十二分之一，必須在12月24日前發放。

events.src: Pag-IBIG housing loans: 5.75% (1-year) and 6.25% (3-year) repricing in 2025; the Affordable Housing Program charges 3% for low-income members, for up to 30 years (Malaya; Tribune, 2025). Real rates (about 0% and 3%) and prices are ESTIMATES.

opts.do: buyAt(.45 * P, { dp: .05, fee: .02, r: 0, n: 30, lk: 'trk.ph_ahp', fixed: true })

opts.ok: liq >= .13 * .8 * P || M('e.home.need', { n: MN(.104 * P), h: MN(liq) })
opts.do: buyAt(.8 * P, { dp: .1, fee: .03, r: .03, n: 30, lk: 'trk.flat' })

en..x: Pag-IBIG housing loans charged 5.75–6.25% a year in 2025; under its Affordable Housing Program, low-income members can buy socialised housing at 3% for up to 30 years. A small home costs {p}; socialised housing about {q}.
en..ahp.s: {d} up front, then {m} a year for 30 years.
en..no: Your income is above the programme’s limit.

zh..x: 2025年Pag-IBIG房贷利率为每年5.75–6.25%；在可负担住房计划下，低收入会员可以用3%的利率买社会住房，最长30年。一间小房子要{p}；社会住房约{q}。
zh..no: 你的收入超过计划的上限。

zht..x: 2025年Pag-IBIG房貸利率為每年5.75–6.25%；在可負擔住房計畫下，低收入會員可以用3%的利率買社會住房，最長30年。一間小房子要{p}；社會住房約{q}。
zht..no: 你的收入超過計畫的上限。

events.src: The IT-BPM industry (call centres and back offices) employed about 1.82 million people in 2024 (IBPAP, via Daily Tribune, Jan 2025); most serve US clients at night, and work between 10 pm and 6 am earns at least 10% more under the Labor Code’s night-shift differential (Art. 86; IBPAP via BusinessWorld). The pay ratio (≈1.2×) and the health effect of night work are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: A call centre in your city is hiring for its US accounts. The pay is better than yours, but the shifts run through the night.
en..bpo.s: Better pay, with a night-shift premium.
en..bpo.h: Pay about 20% higher for five years; Health −1 a year from the nights, Happiness −1.
en.trk.ph_bpo: Night shifts at a call centre

zh..x: 城里一家客服中心在招人，服务美国客户。薪水比你现在高，但都是通宵班。
zh..bpo.s: 薪水较高，还有夜班津贴。
zh..bpo.h: 五年内薪水大约高20%；熬夜让健康每年 −1，幸福感 −1。

zht..x: 城裡一家客服中心在徵人，服務美國客戶。薪水比你現在高，但都是大夜班。
zht..bpo.s: 薪水較高，還有夜班津貼。
zht..bpo.h: 五年內薪水大約高20%；熬夜讓健康每年 −1，幸福感 −1。

events.src: “5-6” lending: borrow ₱5 and repay ₱6, about 20% a month, often collected daily (Inquirer; Wikipedia, “5-6 moneylending”). SSS salary loans charge 10% a year on the diminishing balance (SSS announced a cut to 8% from 2025) and take a week or two (SSS; Moneymax, 2025). ₱10,500 ≈ 0.1 of the game’s typical wage. Costs are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: Your child’s school fees are due and you need {a} this week. The man who lends “5-6” comes by your street every morning.
en..sss.s: Apply online; the money comes in a week or two.

zh..x: 孩子的学费到期了，你这个星期需要{a}。放“5-6”高利贷的人每天早上都会来你家这条街。
zh..family.s: 有点尴尬，但他们帮了你。

zht..x: 孩子的學費到期了，你這個星期需要{a}。放「5-6」高利貸的人每天早上都會來你家這條街。
zht..family.s: 有點尷尬，但他們幫了你。

events.src: Free tuition: the Universal Access to Quality Tertiary Education Act (RA 10931, 2017) made state and local universities tuition-free from AY 2018–19, with 5.48 million beneficiaries to AY 2025–26 (UniFAST). UPCAT 2025: 17,996 of 135,236 examinees admitted, 13.3% (University of the Philippines, via Wikipedia). Private tuition (≈ ₱100,000 a year ≈ 0.95 of the game’s typical wage, 3.8 for four years) and the pay effects are an ESTIMATE.

later.ph_upcat: if (roll('ph_upcat') < .13) { bump('ph_up', 1.05, M('trk.ph_up')); happy += 3; log(M('log.ph_upOk'), 'good') } else log(M('log.ph_upNo'), '')

en..x: You have a place at your provincial state university, free of tuition. You could also sit the UPCAT for the University of the Philippines, or go to a private university in Manila.
en..upcat.s: Free tuition if you get in; a hard exam.
en..upcat.h: About one in eight examinees gets in; UP graduates earn about 5% more.
en..private.s: About {a} for four years, paid by your family.{b}
en.log.ph_upOk: You passed the UPCAT and start at the University of the Philippines.
en.log.ph_upNo: You didn’t get into UP, and start at the state university.

zh..x: 你考上了省里的州立大学，学费全免。你也可以去考菲律宾大学的入学考试（UPCAT），或者去马尼拉念私立大学。
zh..upcat.s: 考上就免学费；考试很难。
zh..upcat.h: 大约八个考生只有一个考上；菲大毕业生薪水大约高5%。
zh.log.ph_upOk: 你考上了UPCAT，进了菲律宾大学。
zh.log.ph_upNo: 你没考上菲大，去念州立大学。

zht..x: 你考上了省裡的州立大學，學費全免。你也可以去考菲律賓大學的入學考試（UPCAT），或者去馬尼拉念私立大學。
zht..upcat.s: 考上就免學費；考試很難。
zht..upcat.h: 大約八個考生只有一個考上；菲大畢業生薪水大約高5%。
zht.log.ph_upOk: 你考上了UPCAT，進了菲律賓大學。
zht.log.ph_upNo: 你沒考上菲大，去念州立大學。

events.src: Sari-sari stores, tiny neighbourhood shops, number over a million across the Philippines (industry estimates); selling on credit (utang, written in a listahan) is common and a leading reason they fail. Start-up cost (₱30,000 ≈ 0.3), profit and odds are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: pay(.3 * base); const tq = T('ph_sari', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.ph_sari')}); tq.v -= .3 * base; rec('ph_sari', -.12 * base, 15); happy += 1

en..x: The front room of your house faces the street. A sari-sari store there could sell snacks, soap and load to the neighbours.
en..open.h: A steady small income, if the neighbours pay their tabs.

zh..x: 你家前厅正对着街。开一家小杂货店，可以卖零食、肥皂和手机储值给邻居。
zh..open.h: 只要邻居肯还赊账，就有稳定的小收入。

zht..x: 你家前廳正對著街。開一家小雜貨店，可以賣零食、肥皂和手機儲值給鄰居。
zht..open.h: 只要鄰居肯還賒帳，就有穩定的小收入。

events.src: ESTIMATE: game rule (unpaid tabs eat into a sari-sari store’s thin margins).

en..x: Your notebook of tabs has grown long: the neighbours owe you about {a}, and a few have stopped coming by.
en..keep.h: Your profit falls by about half.
en..cut.h: Profit holds up, but some neighbours take offence.
en..collect: Go door to door to collect
en..collect.h: You get back about half the time.

zh..x: 你的赊账本越写越长：邻居欠你大约{a}，有几个人干脆不来了。
zh..cut.h: 利润保住了，但有些邻居不高兴。
zh..collect.h: 大约一半的机会能收回来。

zht..x: 你的賒帳本越寫越長：鄰居欠你大約{a}，有幾個人乾脆不來了。
zht..cut.h: 利潤保住了，但有些鄰居不高興。
zht..collect.h: 大約一半的機會能收回來。

events.src: VUL (variable universal life) policies mix life cover with investment funds and charge high fees in the first years, with surrender charges if you stop early (e.g. 5% falling to 0% by year 6 in one insurer’s product terms); not disclosing charges or risks is misleading sales under the Insurance Code, Sec. 370 (Insurance Commission; Inquirer). Many planners advise term insurance plus a separate fund (“buy term and invest the difference”). ₱36,000 a year ≈ 0.34; a term policy (₱6,000) ≈ 0.057. Fees and returns are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: yearly('ph_vul', {amt: .34 * base, until: age + 10}, {fee: .03, lock: age + 10}, 'trk.ph_vul')
T('ph_term', {kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.ph_term')}); rec('ph_term', .057 * base, 20); yearly('ph_btid', {amt: .28 * base, until: age + 10}, {}, 'trk.ph_btid')

en..x: A college friend has become a “financial adviser” and invites you for coffee. She recommends a VUL: life insurance and investment in one.
en..vul.s: About {a} a year for ten years.
en..vul.h: High charges in the early years eat much of what you put in, and stopping early costs more.
en..btid: Term insurance and a separate fund
en..btid.s: About {a} a year for cover, and {b} a year into an index fund.
en..btid.h: The same cover for less, and low fund fees.

zh..x: 大学同学当上了“理财顾问”，约你喝咖啡。她推荐一份VUL：保险加投资一次搞定。
zh..vul.h: 前几年的高额费用会吃掉一大部分保费，提早解约还要再扣钱。
zh..btid: 买定期险，另外投资基金
zh..btid.s: 保障每年大约{a}，另外每年{b}投指数基金。
zh..btid.h: 同样的保障更便宜，基金费用也低。

zht..x: 大學同學當上了「理財顧問」，約你喝咖啡。她推薦一份VUL：保險加投資一次搞定。
zht..vul.h: 前幾年的高額費用會吃掉一大部分保費，提早解約還要再扣錢。
zht..btid: 買定期險，另外投資基金
zht..btid.s: 保障每年大約{a}，另外每年{b}投指數基金。
zht..btid.h: 同樣的保障更便宜，基金費用也低。

events.src: VUL fund values are often far below premiums paid in the first years because of premium and insurance charges; surrendering early adds a surrender charge (insurer product terms; Insurance Commission). The 10% surrender charge is an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: lots.ph_vul.v = 0; lots.ph_vul.tout += .9 * v; cash += .9 * v; stopYearly('ph_vul'); happy -= 1

en..x: Your yearly VUL statement arrives. After all your premiums, the fund is worth only {a}.
en..keep.s: The adviser says it gets better later.
en..keep.h: Charges are lower in later years, but stay higher than a plain fund’s.
en..stop.s: About {a} back after the surrender charge.

zh..x: VUL年度对账单寄来了。缴了这么多保费，基金只值{a}。
zh..keep.h: 后几年费用会降低，但还是比一般基金高。
zh..stop.h: 幸福感 −1；不用再缴保费了。

zht..x: VUL年度對帳單寄來了。繳了這麼多保費，基金只值{a}。
zht..keep.h: 後幾年費用會降低，但還是比一般基金高。
zht..stop.h: 幸福感 −1；不用再繳保費了。

events.src: Metro Manila condos: Colliers counted 79,200 unsold units at end-2025, nearly eight years of sales (a peak of 13.4 years in Q2 2025), with developers offering big discounts (Colliers, via Gulf News and Malaya, 2025–26). Investors buying pre-selling units to rent out face high vacancy. Price growth, rental yield and odds are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: putIn('ph_condo', a, {rate: .005}, 'trk.ph_condo'); T('ph_condoR', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.ph_condoR')}); rec('ph_condoR', -.03 * a, 20)

en..x: A developer’s agent says a pre-selling studio near a business district will pay for itself with rent. The down payment is spread over three years.
en..buy.h: Prices have barely beaten inflation, and many units sit empty.
en..fund.h: Rises and falls with the market.

zh..x: 开发商的业务说，商业区附近一间预售套房，光靠租金就能回本。头期款可以分三年付。
zh..buy.h: 房价涨幅只比通胀高一点，很多房子都空着。

zht..x: 建商的業務說，商業區附近一間預售套房，光靠租金就能回本。頭期款可以分三年付。
zht..buy.h: 房價漲幅只比通膨高一點，很多房子都空著。

events.src: With years of unsold supply, Metro Manila condo owners compete with developers’ discounts for tenants and buyers (Colliers, 2025–26). Sizes are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: lots.ph_condo.v = 0; lots.ph_condo.tout += .85 * v; cash += .85 * v; stopRec('ph_condoR'); happy -= 2

en..x: Your unit was handed over, but the building is half empty and the developer is selling new units at a discount. Nobody wants to rent yours at the price you hoped.
en..hold.s: Less income, and dues to pay.

zh..x: 房子交屋了，可是整栋楼空了一半，开发商还在打折卖新房。没人愿意用你期望的价钱租。
zh..hold.h: 租金少三分之二。幸福感 −1。

zht..x: 房子交屋了，可是整棟樓空了一半，建商還在打折賣新房。沒人願意用你期望的價錢租。
zht..hold.h: 租金少三分之二。幸福感 −1。

events.src: Public schools are free (DepEd); private school tuition commonly runs ₱40,000–100,000 a year (school fee lists, 2025: ESTIMATE), and the ESC voucher programme covers part of private junior high fees for some pupils (DepEd/PEAC). ₱60,000 ≈ 0.57 of the game’s typical wage. Bursary odds are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: T('ph_school', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.ph_school')}); rec('ph_school', .57 * base, 6); kidWin(.15, .7)

en..x: Your child’s public school has fifty pupils to a class. A private Catholic school nearby has a place.
en..private.s: About {a} a year for six years.
en..private.h: Some of its pupils later win university scholarships.
en..public.h: A smaller chance of a scholarship later.

zh..x: 孩子念的公立学校一班五十个学生。附近一所私立天主教学校还有名额。
zh..private.h: 有些学生以后能拿大学奖学金。
zh..public.h: 以后拿奖学金的机会比较小。

zht..x: 孩子念的公立學校一班五十個學生。附近一所私立天主教學校還有名額。
zht..private.h: 有些學生以後能拿大學獎學金。
zht..public.h: 以後拿獎學金的機會比較小。

events.src: Being a ninong or ninang (godparent) at baptisms and weddings is a common honour in the Philippines, and godchildren expect gifts at Christmas (custom). Amounts are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: T('ph_ninong', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.ph_ninong')}); rec('ph_ninong', .03 * base, 15); happy += 1

en..x: Three friends have asked you to be a godparent to their babies this year. Every Christmas, godchildren come by for their aguinaldo.
en..few: Say yes to your closest friend

zh..x: 今年有三个朋友请你当他们宝宝的教父母。每年圣诞节，教子女都会上门拿红包。

zht..x: 今年有三個朋友請你當他們寶寶的教父母。每年聖誕節，教子女都會上門拿紅包。

events.src: Nurses abroad: the Philippines is the largest source of foreign-educated nurses in the United States (Migration Policy Institute), and nurses there earn several times Philippine pay. Taking the NCLEX, credential checks and visa costs, and the pay and cost multiples used here, are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: A recruiter for American hospitals offers to sponsor you if you pass the NCLEX. Pay there would be about {a} a year.

zh..x: 美国医院的招募人员说，只要你考过NCLEX，他们就替你担保。那边年薪大约{a}。

zht..x: 美國醫院的招募人員說，只要你考過NCLEX，他們就替你擔保。那邊年薪大約{a}。

events.src: Jeepney modernisation (PUV Modernization Program, DOTr DO 2017-011): operators had to consolidate into cooperatives or corporations by 30 April 2024 to keep their franchises; modern units cost about ₱2.4–2.8 million each, part-subsidised (DOTr and LTFRB, reported 2024). Your share of the cooperative’s loan and the odds of losing your route are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: T('ph_coop', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.ph_coop')}); rec('ph_coop', .15 * base, 7); happy -= 1

en..x: Your old jeepney must join a cooperative that buys new air-conditioned units, or lose its franchise.
en..coop.s: Your share of the loan: about {a} a year for seven years.
en..coop.h: You keep your route; Happiness −1, it isn’t your own jeep any more.
en..keep.s: No loan, and you hope for an extension.
en..keep.h: Most unconsolidated jeeps lose their routes; your pay would fall for two years.

zh..x: 你的老吉普尼必须加入合作社，一起买有冷气的新车，否则就会失去营运执照。
zh..coop.s: 你要分摊的贷款：七年里每年大约{a}。
zh..coop.h: 路线保住了；幸福感 −1，车不再是自己的了。
zh..keep.h: 没加入的吉普尼大多会失去路线；你两年的收入会下降。

zht..x: 你的老吉普尼必須加入合作社，一起買有冷氣的新車，否則就會失去營運執照。
zht..coop.s: 你要分攤的貸款：七年裡每年大約{a}。
zht..coop.h: 路線保住了；幸福感 −1，車不再是自己的了。
zht..keep.h: 沒加入的吉普尼大多會失去路線；你兩年的收入會下降。
